# MedBook — Corporate Landing Page

## Overview

MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists. The single-page site should feel **modern, professional, and approachable** — think ZocDoc meets a friendly health brand. The target audience is everyday patients looking to quickly find and book a doctor, so clarity and ease-of-use are paramount. Every design choice should reduce friction and build trust.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Use a clean, calming primary blue (think `#0066FF` or similar healthcare blue) paired with white backgrounds and light gray sections for contrast. Accent with a warm teal or green for CTAs and success states.
- **Typography:** A modern sans-serif like Inter or similar — large, confident headings with generous whitespace. Body text should be highly readable at 16px+.
- **Mood:** Bright, airy, optimistic. Use soft shadows, rounded corners on cards, and friendly iconography (line icons or simple filled icons for specialties). Avoid anything clinical or sterile — lean into the "playful" part of the tone with subtle micro-interactions and warm illustration-style visuals.

## Key Priorities

1. **The search bar is the hero experience.** It should be visually dominant, immediately communicating "type here to find a doctor." The autocomplete dropdown interaction must feel snappy and intuitive — this is the core conversion moment.
2. **Specialty cards** need to be scannable and inviting — use recognizable icons and clear labels so users can browse at a glance.
3. **Platform stats** should convey scale and trust without feeling like a wall of numbers. Make them visually punchy.
4. **Mobile responsiveness is critical** — the hamburger menu toggle and overall layout must work flawlessly on small screens since many patients search on their phones.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the full structural breakdown of sections, interactions, and data display requirements.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# MedBook — Find and Book Top Doctors Instantly

## Brand
MedBook is an online healthcare appointment marketplace that connects patients with local doctors, dentists, and specialists for easy same-day booking. The platform empowers patients to search by specialty, location, and insurance, read verified reviews, and book appointments online in minutes — all completely free for patients. The tone is modern, professional, and playful, making healthcare access feel simple and approachable.

Brand colors: #1B1464 (primary navy), #FFD930 (accent yellow), #FFFFFF (background white)

## Hero Content
Title: Find and book the care you need
Subtitle: Search thousands of doctors, dentists, and specialists. Read verified patient reviews. Book appointments instantly — even same-day. It's that easy, and always free.
CTA: "Find a Doctor" | "Search"

Search bar placeholder: Search by condition, specialty, or doctor name
Location field placeholder: City, state, or zip code
Insurance field placeholder: Choose your insurance plan

## Search Bar
The primary search interface includes three fields:
- **Specialty / Condition / Doctor** — autocomplete text input with dropdown suggestions (e.g., "Dentist," "Back pain," "Dr. Sarah Chen")
- **Location** — city, state, or zip code with geolocation auto-detect option
- **Insurance** — dropdown selector with major insurance carriers (Aetna, Blue Cross, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, etc.)

CTA Button: "Search"

## Popular Specialties
A grid of clickable specialty cards that navigate to filtered search results:

- **Primary Care** — Annual checkups, sick visits, and preventive care
- **Dentist** — Cleanings, fillings, and oral health exams
- **Dermatologist** — Skin conditions, acne, and cosmetic consultations
- **Psychiatrist** — Mental health evaluations and medication management
- **Eye Doctor** — Vision exams, glasses prescriptions, and eye health
- **Orthopedic Surgeon** — Joint pain, fractures, and sports injuries

Each card includes a specialty icon and label. Clicking a card triggers a filtered search for that specialty.

## How It Works
A three-step visual guide explaining the MedBook booking flow:

1. **Search for a provider** — Enter your specialty, condition, or doctor name along with your location and insurance. Browse detailed provider profiles with photos, credentials, and office hours.
2. **Choose a time that works for you** — View real-time availability and pick an appointment slot that fits your schedule — including same-day and next-day options.
3. **Book your appointment instantly** — Confirm your visit in just a few clicks. Receive instant confirmation and reminders so you never miss an appointment.

## Platform Statistics
Key metrics displayed as a horizontal stats bar or badge row:

- **4.8M+** verified patient reviews
- **12,000+** healthcare providers nationwide
- **Same-day** appointments available daily
- **100% free** for patients — always

## Testimonials
- "I found a great dermatologist near my office and booked a same-day appointment during my lunch break. MedBook made it incredibly easy." — **Priya M.**, New York, NY
- "As someone new to the city, MedBook helped me find a primary care doctor who accepts my insurance in under five minutes. Highly recommend!" — **James T.**, Chicago, IL
- "I was dreading finding a new dentist, but the verified reviews on MedBook gave me confidence. My appointment was exactly what I needed." — **Laura K.**, Austin, TX

## Mobile App Promo
Title: Your health, in your pocket
Subtitle: Download the MedBook app to search for doctors, manage appointments, and get reminders — all on the go. Available on iOS and Android.
CTA: "Download on the App Store" | "Get it on Google Play"

Key app features:
- Book and manage appointments anywhere
- Get real-time appointment reminders
- Access your visit history and provider details
- Read and leave verified reviews

## Header Navigation
- Logo: MedBook (links to home)
- Nav links: Browse · Help · Log In · Sign Up
- Mobile: Hamburger menu icon toggles a slide-out drawer with Browse, Log In, and Sign Up

**For Providers:** List Your Practice · Provider Resources · Advertise with Us

      --teal: #00C6A2;
      --teal-light: #e0faf5;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --gray-50: #f8f9fc;
      --gray-100: #f1f3f8;
      --gray-200: #e4e7ef;
      --gray-400: #9aa3b8;
      --gray-600: #5a6382;
      --gray-800: #2d3452;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(27,20,100,0.08);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 16px rgba(27,20,100,0.12);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(27,20,100,0.16);
      --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px rgba(27,20,100,0.2);
      --radius: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 20px;
      --radius-xl: 28px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--white);
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    /* ── HEADER ── */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s;
    }
    .header.scrolled { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 72px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    .logo-mark {
      width: 36px; height: 36px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .logo-mark svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .logo span { color: var(--yellow); }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      list-style: none;
    }
    .nav-links a {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }
    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--navy); background: var(--gray-100); }
    .nav-links .btn-login {
      color: var(--navy);
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .nav-links .btn-signup {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 9px 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .nav-links .btn-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-dark); color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      background: none;
      border: none;
    }
    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: transform 0.25s, opacity 0.25s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile nav drawer */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 24px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .mobile-nav a {
      display: block;
      padding: 16px 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--navy); }
    .mobile-nav .mobile-signup {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 24px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white) !important;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border-bottom: none;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      padding-top: 72px;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, #2d2890 55%, #3d48c8 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 580px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-bg-shapes {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-bg-shapes::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px; right: -80px;
      width: 600px; height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .hero-bg-shapes::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -100px; left: -60px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,198,162,0.15) 0%, transparent 65%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 80px 24px 100px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-eyebrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      color: var(--white);
      max-width: 780px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-title em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 20px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
      max-width: 580px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ── SEARCH CARD ── */
    .search-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 28px 28px 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      max-width: 900px;
    }

    .search-form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr auto;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: end;
    }

    .search-field {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .search-field label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .search-field input,
    .search-field select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      outline: none;
      appearance: none;
    }
    .search-field input:focus,
    .search-field select:focus {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,102,255,0.1);
    }
    .search-field input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .search-field .field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .search-field .field-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .search-field select {
      padding-right: 40px;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .search-field select.has-value { color: var(--gray-800); }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 6px);
      left: 0; right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--blue);
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 100;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: none;
    }
    .autocomplete-dropdown.visible { display: block; }
    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.1s;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .autocomplete-item:hover,
    .autocomplete-item.focused { background: var(--blue-light); }
    .autocomplete-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--blue); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .autocomplete-item .item-label { font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-800); }
    .autocomplete-item .item-type { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); margin-left: auto; }

    .btn-search {
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--navy);
      border: none;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      white-space: nowrap;
      height: 48px;
    }
    .btn-search:hover {
      background: var(--yellow-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255,217,48,0.5);
    }
    .btn-search svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    .hero-trust {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .trust-item svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── STATS BAR ── */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--navy);
      padding: 0;
    }

    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    }

    .stat-item {
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .stat-item + .stat-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 25%; bottom: 25%;
      width: 1px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      color: var(--yellow);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ── SECTION SHARED ── */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }
    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    /* ── SPECIALTIES ── */
    .specialties-section { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .specialty-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .specialty-icon {
      width: 60px; height: 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-name { color: var(--blue); }

    /* ── HOW IT WORKS ── */
    .how-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .steps-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 36px;
    }
    .step {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .step-number {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .step-content {}
    .step-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .how-illustration {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--blue-light) 0%, var(--teal-light) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px 40px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* Faux app card */
    .app-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .app-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .app-card-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
    .app-card-specialty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-400); }
    .app-card-stars { color: #FFAA00; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .app-card-stars span { color: var(--gray-400); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 4px; }

    .slot-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .slot {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      color: var(--blue);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .slot.available-today {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .slot.selected {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .confirm-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .confirm-btn:hover { background: #00b394; }

    /* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */
    .testimonials-section { background: var(--navy); }
    .testimonials-section .section-eyebrow { color: var(--yellow); }
    .testimonials-section .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .testimonial-stars { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .author-avatar {
      width: 42px; height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .author-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); }
    .author-location { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

    /* ── APP PROMO ── */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--blue-light) 100%);
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-features-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 32px 0;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }
    .app-feature svg {
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .store-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .store-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .store-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .store-btn-sub { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; display: block; }

    .app-mockup {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      max-width: 320px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      position: relative;
    }
    .app-mockup::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 80px; height: 5px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-screen {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 20px 16px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }
    .mockup-greeting {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-name {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      opacity: 0.6;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-doc {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-time {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.4);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }
    .mockup-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .mockup-action {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
    }
    .mockup-action.teal { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 72px 24px 40px;

    { label: 'Physical Therapist', type: 'Specialty' },
  ];

  const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty-input');
  const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialty-dropdown');
  let focusedIndex = -1;

  function getIcon(type) {
    if (type === 'Doctor') return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="3"/><path d="M3 14c0-3 2-5 5-5s5 2 5 5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;

    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="2" y="2" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 5v6M5 8h6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
  }

  function renderDropdown(items) {
    if (!items.length) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    dropdown.innerHTML = items.map((item, i) =>
      `<div class="autocomplete-item" role="option" data-index="${i}" data-value="${item.label}" aria-selected="false">

        <span class="item-label">${item.label}</span>
        <span class="item-type">${item.type}</span>
      </div>`
    ).join('');
    dropdown.classList.add('visible');
    specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    focusedIndex = -1;
  }

  specialtyInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const query = specialtyInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 6);
    renderDropdown(filtered);
  });

  specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      focusedIndex = Math.min(focusedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      focusedIndex = Math.max(focusedIndex - 1, 0);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && focusedIndex >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      selectItem(items[focusedIndex].dataset.value);
      return;
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      item.classList.toggle('focused', i === focusedIndex);
      item.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === focusedIndex);
    });
  });

  dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');

  function selectItem(value) {

      slot.closest('.slot-row').querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));

    /* ── SPECIALTIES ── */
    .specialties-section { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;

    .specialty-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .specialty-icon {
      width: 60px; height: 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-name { color: var(--blue); }

    /* ── HOW IT WORKS ── */
    .how-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .steps-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 36px;
    }
    .step {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .step-number {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .step-content {}
    .step-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .how-illustration {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--blue-light) 0%, var(--teal-light) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px 40px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* Faux app card */
    .app-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .app-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);

      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      flex-shrink: 0;

    .app-card-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
    .app-card-specialty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-400); }
    .app-card-stars { color: #FFAA00; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .app-card-stars span { color: var(--gray-400); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 4px; }

    .slot-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .slot {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      color: var(--blue);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .slot.available-today {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .slot.selected {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .confirm-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      margin-top: 8px;

    /* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */

    .testimonials-section .section-eyebrow { color: var(--yellow); }
    .testimonials-section .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .testimonial-stars { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .author-avatar {
      width: 42px; height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .author-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); }
    .author-location { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

    /* ── APP PROMO ── */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--blue-light) 100%);
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-features-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 32px 0;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }
    .app-feature svg {
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .store-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .store-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .store-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .store-btn-sub { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; display: block; }

    .app-mockup {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      max-width: 320px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      position: relative;
    }
    .app-mockup::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; left: 50%;

      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-screen {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 20px 16px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }
    .mockup-greeting {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-name {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;

      margin-bottom: 6px;

    .mockup-upcoming-doc {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-time {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.4);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }
    .mockup-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .mockup-action {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
    }
    .mockup-action.teal { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 72px 24px 40px;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo { color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .footer-brand .logo-mark { background: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-brand .logo span { color: var(--navy); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 260px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--yellow); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .footer-tagline-pill {
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.25);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
    }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .search-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .btn-search { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-content: center; }
      .how-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .how-illustration { display: none; }
      .app-promo-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .app-mockup { display: none; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stat-item:nth-child(3)::before,
      .stat-item:nth-child(4)::before { display: none; }
      .stat-item:nth-child(odd)::before { display: none; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav { display: block; }

      .search-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .btn-search { grid-column: 1; }

      .section { padding: 64px 20px; }
      .hero-inner { padding: 60px 20px 80px; }

      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .store-buttons { flex-direction: column; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .animate-up { animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease forwards; }
    .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; opacity: 0; }
    .delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; opacity: 0; }
    .delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; opacity: 0; }
  </style>
</head>

<script>
  // ── Header scroll shadow ──
  const header = document.getElementById('site-header');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
  }, { passive: true });

  // ── Mobile menu toggle ──
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');

  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const isOpen = hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    mobileNav.classList.toggle('open', isOpen);
    hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
    document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
  });

  // Close mobile nav when a link is clicked
  mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', () => {
      hamburger.classList.remove('open');
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    });
  });

  // ── Autocomplete search ──
  const suggestions = [
    { label: 'Primary Care', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Dentist', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Dermatologist', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Psychiatrist', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Eye Doctor', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Orthopedic Surgeon', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Back pain', type: 'Condition' },
    { label: 'Anxiety', type: 'Condition' },
    { label: 'Skin rash', type: 'Condition' },
    { label: 'Knee pain', type: 'Condition' },
    { label: 'Headache', type: 'Condition' },
    { label: 'Dr. Sarah Chen', type: 'Doctor' },
    { label: 'Dr. James Lee', type: 'Doctor' },
    { label: 'Dr. Maria Santos', type: 'Doctor' },
    { label: 'Cardiologist', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Pediatrician', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'OB-GYN', type: 'Specialty' },
    { label: 'Physical Therapist', type: 'Specialty' },
  ];

  const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty-input');
  const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialty-dropdown');
  let focusedIndex = -1;

  function getIcon(type) {
    if (type === 'Doctor') return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="3"/><path d="M3 14c0-3 2-5 5-5s5 2 5 5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
    if (type === 'Condition') return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><path d="M8 2v4M8 10v1" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6"/></svg>`;
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="2" y="2" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 5v6M5 8h6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;
  }

  function renderDropdown(items) {
    if (!items.length) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    dropdown.innerHTML = items.map((item, i) =>
      `<div class="autocomplete-item" role="option" data-index="${i}" data-value="${item.label}" aria-selected="false">
        ${getIcon(item.type)}
        <span class="item-label">${item.label}</span>
        <span class="item-type">${item.type}</span>
      </div>`
    ).join('');
    dropdown.classList.add('visible');
    specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    focusedIndex = -1;
  }

  specialtyInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const query = specialtyInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 6);
    renderDropdown(filtered);
  });

  specialtyInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('.autocomplete-item');
    if (!items.length) return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      focusedIndex = Math.min(focusedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      focusedIndex = Math.max(focusedIndex - 1, 0);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && focusedIndex >= 0) {
      e.preventDefault();
      selectItem(items[focusedIndex].dataset.value);
      return;
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    items.forEach((item, i) => {
      item.classList.toggle('focused', i === focusedIndex);
      item.setAttribute('aria-selected', i === focusedIndex);
    });
  });

  dropdown.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const item = e.target.closest('.autocomplete-item');
    if (item) selectItem(item.dataset.value);
  });

  function selectItem(value) {
    specialtyInput.value = value;
    dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
    specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    specialtyInput.focus();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest('#specialty-field')) {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  // ── Specialty card clicks ──
  document.querySelectorAll('.specialty-card').forEach(card => {
    const handleActivate = () => {
      const specialty = card.dataset.specialty;
      specialtyInput.value = specialty;
      document.getElementById('specialty-input').focus();
      // Scroll to hero
      document.querySelector('.hero').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    };
    card.addEventListener('click', handleActivate);
    card.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); handleActivate(); }
    });
  });

  // ── Insurance select styling ──
  const insuranceSelect = document.getElementById('insurance-select');
  insuranceSelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
    insuranceSelect.classList.toggle('has-value', insuranceSelect.value !== '');

  // ── Search form submit ──

    slot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      slot.closest('.slot-row').querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
      slot.classList.add('selected');
    });

</script>

    .nav-links .btn-signup {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 9px 20px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .nav-links .btn-signup:hover { background: var(--navy-dark); color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      background: none;
      border: none;
    }
    .hamburger:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }
    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: transform 0.25s, opacity 0.25s;
    }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
    .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

    /* Mobile nav drawer */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 72px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 24px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow-y: auto;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .mobile-nav a {
      display: block;
      padding: 16px 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .mobile-nav a:hover { color: var(--navy); }
    .mobile-nav .mobile-signup {
      display: inline-block;
      margin-top: 24px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white) !important;
      padding: 14px 32px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border-bottom: none;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    /* ── HERO ── */
    .hero {
      padding-top: 72px;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy) 0%, #2d2890 55%, #3d48c8 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 580px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-bg-shapes {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-bg-shapes::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: -120px; right: -80px;
      width: 600px; height: 600px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,217,48,0.12) 0%, transparent 65%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }
    .hero-bg-shapes::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -100px; left: -60px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0,198,162,0.15) 0%, transparent 65%);
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .hero-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 80px 24px 100px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 100px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-eyebrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 64px);
      font-weight: 900;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -2px;
      color: var(--white);
      max-width: 780px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-title em {
      font-style: normal;
      color: var(--yellow);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 20px);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
      max-width: 580px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ── SEARCH CARD ── */
    .search-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 28px 28px 28px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      max-width: 900px;
    }

    .search-form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr auto;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: end;
    }

    .search-field {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .search-field label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .search-field input,
    .search-field select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-family: inherit;
      color: var(--gray-800);
      background: var(--gray-50);
      transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      outline: none;
      appearance: none;
    }
    .search-field input:focus,
    .search-field select:focus {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,102,255,0.1);
    }
    .search-field input::placeholder { color: var(--gray-400); }

    .search-field .field-icon {
      position: absolute;
      right: 14px;
      bottom: 14px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .search-field .field-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    .search-field select {
      padding-right: 40px;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }
    .search-field select.has-value { color: var(--gray-800); }

    /* Autocomplete dropdown */
    .autocomplete-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 6px);
      left: 0; right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--blue);
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 100;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: none;
    }
    .autocomplete-dropdown.visible { display: block; }
    .autocomplete-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.1s;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .autocomplete-item:hover,
    .autocomplete-item.focused { background: var(--blue-light); }
    .autocomplete-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--blue); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .autocomplete-item .item-label { font-weight: 600; color: var(--gray-800); }
    .autocomplete-item .item-type { font-size: 12px; color: var(--gray-400); margin-left: auto; }

    .btn-search {
      background: var(--yellow);
      color: var(--navy);
      border: none;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.15s;
      white-space: nowrap;
      height: 48px;
    }
    .btn-search:hover {
      background: var(--yellow-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255,217,48,0.5);
    }
    .btn-search svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }

    .hero-trust {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .trust-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }
    .trust-item svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── STATS BAR ── */
    .stats-bar {
      background: var(--navy);
      padding: 0;
    }

    .stats-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    }

    .stat-item {
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
    }
    .stat-item + .stat-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0; top: 25%; bottom: 25%;
      width: 1px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      color: var(--yellow);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ── SECTION SHARED ── */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
    }
    .section-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -1px;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }

    /* ── SPECIALTIES ── */
    .specialties-section { background: var(--gray-50); }

    .specialties-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .specialty-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .specialty-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .specialty-icon {
      width: 60px; height: 60px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .specialty-name {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }
    .specialty-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .specialty-card:hover .specialty-name { color: var(--blue); }

    /* ── HOW IT WORKS ── */
    .how-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .steps-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 36px;
    }
    .step {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .step-number {
      width: 48px; height: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .step-content {}
    .step-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .step-desc {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .how-illustration {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--blue-light) 0%, var(--teal-light) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: 48px 40px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* Faux app card */
    .app-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .app-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 44px; height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue) 0%, var(--teal) 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .app-card-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); }
    .app-card-specialty { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gray-400); }
    .app-card-stars { color: #FFAA00; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .app-card-stars span { color: var(--gray-400); font-size: 12px; margin-left: 4px; }

    .slot-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .slot {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      color: var(--blue);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
    }
    .slot.available-today {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .slot.selected {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .confirm-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .confirm-btn:hover { background: #00b394; }

    /* ── TESTIMONIALS ── */
    .testimonials-section { background: var(--navy); }
    .testimonials-section .section-eyebrow { color: var(--yellow); }
    .testimonials-section .section-title { color: var(--white); }

    .testimonials-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px 28px;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    .testimonial-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }
    .testimonial-stars { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .author-avatar {
      width: 42px; height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .author-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); }
    .author-location { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

    /* ── APP PROMO ── */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--blue-light) 100%);
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-features-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 32px 0;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }
    .app-feature svg {
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .store-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }
    .store-btn:hover { background: var(--navy-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .store-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .store-btn-sub { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; display: block; }

    .app-mockup {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 32px;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      max-width: 320px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      position: relative;
    }
    .app-mockup::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px; left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 80px; height: 5px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-screen {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 20px 16px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }
    .mockup-greeting {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .mockup-name {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming {
      background: var(--navy);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      color: white;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      opacity: 0.6;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-doc {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-time {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.75;
    }
    .mockup-upcoming-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.4);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }
    .mockup-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .mockup-action {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--blue-light);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);
    }
    .mockup-action.teal { background: var(--teal-light); color: var(--teal); }

    /* ── FOOTER ── */
    .footer {
      background: var(--navy-dark);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      padding: 72px 24px 40px;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 56px;
    }
    .footer-brand .logo { color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .footer-brand .logo-mark { background: var(--yellow); }
    .footer-brand .logo span { color: var(--navy); }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 260px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .footer-col ul li a {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      transition: color 0.15s;
    }
    .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--yellow); }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .footer-tagline-pill {
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.25);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
    }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .search-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .btn-search { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-content: center; }
      .how-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .how-illustration { display: none; }
      .app-promo-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .app-mockup { display: none; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stat-item:nth-child(3)::before,
      .stat-item:nth-child(4)::before { display: none; }
      .stat-item:nth-child(odd)::before { display: none; }

  // ── Mobile menu toggle ──

  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');

  ];

  const specialtyInput = document.getElementById('specialty-input');
  const dropdown = document.getElementById('specialty-dropdown');
  let focusedIndex = -1;

  function getIcon(type) {
    if (type === 'Doctor') return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="3"/><path d="M3 14c0-3 2-5 5-5s5 2 5 5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;

    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="2" y="2" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M8 5v6M5 8h6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>`;

        <span class="item-label">${item.label}</span>
        <span class="item-type">${item.type}</span>

    specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    focusedIndex = -1;

    if (!query) {

      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      return;
    }
    const filtered = suggestions.filter(s => s.label.toLowerCase().includes(query)).slice(0, 6);

      e.preventDefault();
      focusedIndex = Math.max(focusedIndex - 1, 0);
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && focusedIndex >= 0) {

      return;
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      dropdown.classList.remove('visible');
      specialtyInput.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

    }

    });
  });

    });
  });

  // ── Search form submit ──

    slot.addEventListener('click', () => {
      slot.closest('.slot-row').querySelectorAll('.slot').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('selected'));
      slot.classList.add('selected');
    });
  });
</script>

      color: var(--blue);

    .slot.available-today {
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
    }
    .slot.selected {
      background: var(--blue);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .confirm-btn {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;

    .testimonial-stars { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; }

      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-style: italic;

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .author-avatar {

      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--navy);
      flex-shrink: 0;

    .author-location { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

    /* ── APP PROMO ── */
    .app-promo {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-50) 0%, var(--blue-light) 100%);
    }
    .app-promo-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .app-features-list {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      margin: 32px 0;
    }
    .app-feature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 12px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }
    .app-feature svg {
      width: 20px; height: 20px;
      color: var(--teal);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .store-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .store-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;

      text-align: center;

      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--blue);

    /* ── FOOTER ── */

    }

    .footer-tagline {

      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 260px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    }

    .footer-col h4 {

      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);

    }

      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .footer-copyright {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .footer-tagline-pill {
      background: rgba(255,217,48,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,217,48,0.25);
      color: var(--yellow);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 100px;
    }

    /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .search-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .btn-search { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-content: center; }
      .how-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .how-illustration { display: none; }
      .app-promo-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
      .app-mockup { display: none; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stat-item:nth-child(3)::before,
      .stat-item:nth-child(4)::before { display: none; }
      .stat-item:nth-child(odd)::before { display: none; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav { display: block; }

      .search-form { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .btn-search { grid-column: 1; }

      .section { padding: 64px 20px; }
      .hero-inner { padding: 60px 20px 80px; }

      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .testimonials-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

      .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .specialties-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .store-buttons { flex-direction: column; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .animate-up { animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease forwards; }
    .delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; opacity: 0; }
    .delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; opacity: 0; }
    .delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; opacity: 0; }
  </style>
</head>
